column_description: INTEGER. Foreign key to the races table (RAK_ID). FK to races. Example: 911.
INTEGER. Foreign key to the drivers table (DRV_MAIN). FK to drivers. Example: 3.
INTEGER. Unique identifier for the pit stop. Possible values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.
INTEGER. Moment during the race when the pit stop occurs. Example: 19.
VARCHAR. Timestamp of the pit stop. **NULL means the exact pit-stop time wasn't logged.**. Example: 14:41:14.
TEXT. Duration of the pit stop. Example: 22.936.
INTEGER. Millisecond count for the pit stop. Example: 22936.
